g.text: Shelter Detail, Trust Reports & Submission Flow (M5-M6, M8, M11)
The detail read is public for ALL statuses (incl. auto-hidden / rejected).
Header badges come from the shared copy, only when the DTO carries the
state (never client-derived): the provenance chip (provenance), the
(openStatus) and the occupancy text (occupancy - firm or hedged band).
Location section: a static Leaflet map (page-scoped LeafletService,
the same service as /map) flown to the shelter (SHELTER_ZOOM 16) with
one non-interactive marker. The header also carries the navigate deep
links (Google Maps walking / Apple Maps, target=_blank rel=noopener)
and the "Distance from you" action (client-side Haversine - no backend
shelter info + location map + navigate/distance actions
Verified only: anonymous / unverified get the login/verify prompts.
The picker offers NON_EXISTENT, WRONG_LOCATION and OTHER (the factual
types carry a detail field, <= 500 chars); CLOSED / OPEN_CONFIRMED stay
in the ShelterReportType union for stored rows but are no longer picker
options - open/closed has its own live picker below. One report per
(shelter, user, type); the duplicate check (409) runs BEFORE the shared
per-user throttle budget (10 report-type actions / rolling hour -> 429).
"Report" -> pick a type + detail (factual types only)
get(123) ' the trust badges may have changed
picker closed + success notice (damped copy when true) + refetched shelter
the server's message inline near the picker
Three large band buttons (Space available / Getting full / Full) -
one tap, latest-wins upsert (NO 409: a re-tap is the update).
Pre-selected from the detail DTO's yourOccupancyBand. Display-only
server-side: 2 h freshness, latest fresh band wins, 1 agreeing report
Two state buttons (Open / Closed) - one live state per user per
shelter, latest edit wins (NO 409: a re-tap is the update). Pre-selected
from the detail DTO's yourOpenStatus. NOT throttled - a tap is a state,
not a report action (it consumes no action-log budget). Display-only
server-side: 2 h freshness, the latest fresh state wins, 1 agreeing
Route /submit guarded by AuthGuard + VerifiedGuard. The location
section keeps ONE shared location signal written by FIVE capture
modes: (1) smart text input - coordinate strings (incl. DMS, auto
lng/lat swap), long-form map URLs parsed client-side by the pure
geolocation; (3) mini-map click/drag; (4) maps.app.goo.gl short links
resolved by the backend (POST /api/geo/resolve); (5) Estonia address
search - client-side Nominatim geocoding via GeocodeGateway (one
deliberate request per press, hard 1 req/s spacing, always-rendered
coordinate readout (+ source/swapped/accuracy hints) is a DISPLAY of
the shared signal, not a capture mode. A FAILED capture clears the pin
(never a silent stale pin) - a failed address SEARCH never touches the
pin (inline state only, never blocks submit). The page pre-checks the
Estonia bbox client-side (inline error, nothing is sent) and the
capture the location (any order, repeats allowed)
shared location set - marker + read-only readout
inline error on no-pair / out-of-bounds / invalid
marker at device position + accuracy hint
shared location set (same as a pick)
inline error (pin cleared; 429 = "try again in a minute")
results (429 -> "please wait a moment"; network -> generic copy)
shared location set + address field prefilled ONLY IF empty
A failed SEARCH (no results / 429 / network) never touches the pin -
inline state only, never blocks submit.
[400 out-of-Estonia/fields / 401 anonymous / 403 not verified / 409 cap or near-duplicate / 429 daily cap]
banner with message (input preserved; 403 adds a /verify link; 409 = "The limit of 10 active shelters has been reached")
USER-submitted rows are sacred on the backend: the registry
embedded in AccountPage). It lists the caller's own shelters (the
review half is gone with the review model); each row carries its
reviewStatus (NEW / CONFIRMED / REJECTED), the admin's reviewNote and
the moderator's infoRequest when present. Edits are inline-expanding
forms (no modals); deletes are two-step confirms (no window.confirm).
MineShelterDto[] (the caller's USER rows, ALL statuses)
Auto-hidden (INACTIVE) and REJECTED rows stay in the owner's list, each
marked "Hidden - reported by the community (N reports)" (or the admin's
REJECT reason) - no restore action (restore is admin-only).
ShelterDto -> row updated in place (no page reload)
ErrorResponse -> banner via bannerMessage, row unchanged
204 No Content -> row removed (reports and occupancy cascade)
row patched in place (the reply is read-only afterwards)
